newsitem.title: INDIA: Rebels kill six soldiers in northeast India ambush.
newsitem.headline: Rebels kill six soldiers in northeast India ambush.

text.p: Tribal separatist guerrillas ambushed an army convoy on Monday in the northeastern state of Nagaland, killing six soldiers, police said.
They said the rebels attacked the convoy about 150 km (90 miles) from the state capital Kohima. Ten soldiers were wounded.

Separatist insurgents have been active for about four decades in India's seven northeastern states, fighting either for independence or for their own states within India. Police say more than 1,000 people have been killed in Nagaland alone.
